verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a general claim of reduced processing times and per-filing status tracking (progress visibility, 'Suivre l'avancement du dépôt d'actes'). Neither amounts to the service publishing current processing times by transaction type. Status tracking of one's own dossier is an adjacent feature and does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
